verdicts.reason: A keeps the label frame and text stack intact, with the illustrations spread along the bottom. But the rules from under 'LAVANDER' have broken off and float to the right of the frame, and the small rules beside HOMEMADE LOTION have drifted out of place, one of them striking through the jar on the left. B is unusable: the label frame sits empty on the right while the text floats on bare background. The reading order is scrambled (J'adore Paris now sits below LOTION), the stray rules are scattered, and the illustrations are shrunk into a tiny strip that touches 'SKINCARE'.
